sc: Child with measles cannot see at dusk, foamy grey patch on the conjunctiva → Vitamin A deficiency (Bitot spot)
Weaned infant with rash around mouth and anus, diarrhoea, hair loss → Zinc deficiency (acrodermatitis enteropathica)
Infant on boiled cow's milk, refuses to move painful legs, bleeding gums → Scurvy
f: Earliest symptom night blindness · earliest sign Bitot spot · corneal xerosis → keratomalacia (blindness)
Day 1, day 2 (and week 2 if eye signs): < 6 mo 50 000 · 6–11 mo 100 000 · ≥ 12 mo 200 000 IU · every child with measles or SAM
Diarrhoea: 10 mg (< 6 mo), 20 mg (≥ 6 mo) daily for 10–14 days · acrodermatitis enteropathica: zinc for life
B1 → beriberi (heart failure) · B2 → angular stomatitis · B3 → pellagra (3 Ds) · B6 → neuropathy on isoniazid, seizures · B12 → vegan mother
Iodine → commonest preventable intellectual disability (iodised salt) · vitamin C → scurvy · vitamin E → haemolysis in preterm · vitamin K → bleeding
Vitamin K 1 mg IM at birth · pyridoxine trial 100 mg IV for resistant neonatal seizures
trap: Night blindness is the earliest symptom, Bitot spot the earliest sign · too much vitamin A → raised ICP (bulging fontanelle) · "B12 → pellagra" is the false pair (pellagra is niacin)
